description.value:
You spent years working in service to a galaxy-spanning faction — political, religious, criminal, or otherwise — whose reach paid no mind to planetary borders. You might have run messages between safehouses, held a cache of supplies for operatives passing through, or simply kept your ears open in a dozen cantinas on your faction's behalf.

Wherever your loyalties truly lie now, you still know the signs, the passwords, and the favors owed among those who serve the same banner — and they haven't forgotten you either.

system.equipment: A badge or token of your faction, a copy of one of its foundational texts (or a coded logbook, for a clandestine faction), a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 150 credits.
